A few people are messaging me here and on the Geek asking for a status update and/or payment details.

The order was placed on 30th Nov; >G seem to be very busy in their warehouse at the moment and order status isn't always being updated, so it may or may not have shipped out yet. I am waiting for the parcel to arrive before I ask for payments from anyone, so please be patient and I will update you all with further details soon enough!

posts.name: Mezike
posts.cooked:
The parcel is here! Well, almost sort of. The bad news is that it was unsurprisingly held in customs and walloped with a nearly £40 charge for VAT and handling. Fortunately there are so many things in that box that the impact per set of cards is minimal. The delivery should finally come through on Thursday so I can start packing and shipping over the weekend!

The final price (including purchase price, transaction fees, shipping, and customs charges) comes to £1.76 per pack of cards plus P&P. Please refer to the list below for how much you need to send to me in total as payment - if you are not on the list below I will contact you directly.

Please send payments via PayPal to m3zik3 and this is at gmail dot com. Remember to send as a gift or cover the fees at your end if you are feeling generous toward PayPal. Please ensure that you include both your username and your postal details in the payment so that I can process the shipping quickly and easily!
